name: Tenshi no Wana
source:
Main character was leading a normal school life till an angel visited him depriving him of virginity. After that things start to change around him - men and women start masturbating and having sex everywhere. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公本来过着平凡的校园生活，直到一名天使突然来访并夺走了他的童贞。从此，身边的一切开始改变：男人和女人随处自慰、交媾，整个世界都陷入欲望之中。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
